notes.text: Fixed screen fades in MCC campaign maps.
Fixed repeat races in Rally and weapon movement speeds in Bigass.
Fixed repeated equipment selection in MeinCrap.
Fixed a dark layer over Frogfoot's water.
Fixed missing light glows on AMD graphics cards.
Improved rendering performance on NVIDIA graphics cards.
Added text chat for private multiplayer games.
Mute a player's voice and text chat from the scoreboard.
Added streamer mode to hide offensive words in names and other text.
Access multiplayer chat settings from the pause menu, including co-op.
Raised the maximum map sharing speeds.
Refreshed the browser launcher with a clearer Ready to Play screen.
Improved browser multiplayer on unreliable connections.
Fixed the browser loading notice and joining games from browser rooms.
Added optional bots for local Slayer games through the Xbox menus.
Co-op hosts can add extra weapons, pickups and vehicles.
Added a personal friendly-fire toggle to the online co-op pause menu.
Added optional third-person views for Warthog and Scorpion passengers in campaign and co-op.
Added the Bumper Jumper controller layout.
Added an alternate Linux driver option for PlayStation controllers.
Added optional HDR lighting and output for supported HDR displays.
Added texture filtering and model detail options for sharper distant scenery.
Added an Extra Effects menu for optional visual effects.
Added an optional multiplayer match clock.
Added a connection meter and colour-coded scoreboard ping readings.
Hosts can disable optional mouse aim assist while keeping controller and touch assistance.
Fixed starting split-screen matches without another computer joining.
PC menu text now follows the language of your Custom Edition maps where available.
The main menu background now keeps playing behind other menus.
Added 5.1 surround sound and adjustable audio buffering on Windows and Linux.
Game setup can find an Xbox disc image placed beside the executable.
Improved startup on NVIDIA systems using a Linux Wayland desktop.
